For PDF documents in PAdES format you can enable a visible seal, rotation, QR, metadata, and specific pages or all pages. You can keep selectors open or position the seal without rushing: the connected channel allows up to 30 minutes of inactivity.

CSC remote signing (prototype, off by default):
  Turn it on with "firma_remota_csc": true in config.json or through your organisation's policy, which always takes precedence.
  grxfirma -csc-url <https://...> -csc-client-id <id> -csc-listar-credenciales
  grxfirma -csc-url <https://...> -csc-client-id <id> -csc-credencial <id> -entrada doc.pdf -salida firmado.pdf -formato pades
  -csc-url <url>            https address of the provider's signing service
  -csc-client-id <id>       Client identifier issued by the provider (no secret)
  -csc-credencial <id>      Remote certificate used to sign
  -csc-listar-credenciales  Lists the remote certificates in the account
  You authorise access in the browser, on the same host as the service, and the PIN or OTP code is read from standard input. Only the document digest leaves the computer.
